I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't check the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. because I found no Brackenwater account record or contract that I can see.

My reply asks her to treat the date as a lead, not a confirmed date, and to check it with the customer or the contract before anyone plans around it. One correction: my reply says I "noted" the date, but I haven't saved it anywhere. It exists only in the channel thread.
